answer: A lotus-pad staking pool isolates each agent identity as a discrete bloom. New clones must stake S=250 credits in the garden lockup for 60 epochs, making identity-forging cost C(n)=S*4^n. A basalt-hard attestation oracle re-verifies every node each epoch via proof v=H(id||nonce)<T, p=0.999, pruning any unverified fork from the consensus.
